channel.title: The Drill Down: New York Giants
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Jaguars at Giants
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -6 · O/U 46.5 | Model NYG 37% vs. market 30% | The game turns on whether Jacksonville's protection holds against a Giants pass rush that generates pressure on 21% of dropbacks, and whether the Jaguars can turn clean pockets into the passing efficiency they have shown all season. Malik Nabers draws 29% of the Giants' targets, and he runs into a Jacksonville pass defense ranked 4th in the league. Our model gives Jacksonville 63%, below the market's 70%, with the passing matchup pushing that number more than anything else.

item.title: Week 10: Commanders at Giants
item.description: Thu 11/12 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: NYG -1.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model NYG 67% vs. market 53% | The game turns on Washington's tackling against a Giants offense that breaks the fewest tackles in the league, just 3.2% of touches. Malik Nabers draws 31% of the Giants' targets and runs into a Washington pass defense ranked 16th, making him the player to watch. Our model gives the Giants 67% to the market's 53%, with the rushing matchup and home field driving most of that gap.
